claim_verbatim: By 2028-2029, household integration will scale up, with elder care robotics becoming standard for mobility assistance and medication reminders in ageing societies like Japan and Europe.
resolution_criterion: YES if by end-2029 elder-care robots for mobility/medication are described as standard/mainstream in Japan or major EU markets by national stats or industry associations; NO if niche.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if by end-2029 elder-care robots for mobility/medication are described as standard/mainstream in Japan or major EU markets by national stats or industry associations; NO if niche.

claim_verbatim: The “valley of death” for ammunition supply in 2026-2027 is a very real prospect.
resolution_criterion: YES if US/NATO official reporting in 2026–27 documents sustained critical ammunition stock shortfalls vs stated requirements; NO if inventories/production meet requirements without such shortfall narrative.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if US/NATO official reporting in 2026–27 documents sustained critical ammunition stock shortfalls vs stated requirements; NO if inventories/production meet requirements without such shortfall narrative.
notes: Very real prospect mapped to likely/0.70.

resolution_rule_fixed: YES if major new Western midstream refining plants for critical minerals remain largely not-yet-online through 2026–2028; NO if multiple major plants reach commercial production before end-2028.
